steps: +: Listen to your teacher. Say "thank you", "please" and "goodbye". Read a lot of books. Be a good friend. Answer the teacher's questions.
−: Don't play computer games in class. Don't run and jump in the classroom. Don't sit on the windowsill. Don't put your bag on the floor. Don't take food to the classroom.
